lines.text: A great eagle takes the top of the cedar from Lebanon and plants it in a city of traders.
The vine becomes low and spreading, then bends its roots toward a second eagle so he might water it.
God says the vine will completely wither when the west wind strikes it.
The king of Babylon makes a covenant with a royal family member, who rebels and sends envoys to Assyria.
The LORD will plant a tender sprig on the mountain heights of Israel, where it becomes a majestic cedar.
